# 详情页

一条记录的标题与操作（含「更多」菜单）；字段用 Descriptions 展示，Panel 中放量表，Tabs 的内容各自加载。归档提供「撤销」，删除要求输入名称。活动记录的第一次请求会失败，用来展示标签页内的错误状态。

**难度**：入门　**用到的组件**：[Avatar](../components/Avatar.md), [Button](../components/Button.md), [Descriptions](../components/Descriptions.md), [Dropdown](../components/Dropdown.md), [EmptyState](../components/EmptyState.md), [ErrorState](../components/ErrorState.md), [Grid](../components/Grid.md), [IconButton](../components/IconButton.md), [Inline](../components/Inline.md), [ListItem](../components/ListItem.md), [Loading](../components/Loading.md), [Page](../components/Page.md), [PageSkeleton](../components/PageSkeleton.md), [Panel](../components/Panel.md), [Pill](../components/Pill.md), [Progress](../components/Progress.md), [Stack](../components/Stack.md), [Tabs](../components/Tabs.md), [Text](../components/Text.md), [Timeline](../components/Timeline.md), [useConfirmDanger](../components/useConfirmDanger.md), [useMessage](../components/useMessage.md)

```tsx
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import {
  Avatar,
  Button,
  Descriptions,
  Dropdown,
  EmptyState,
  ErrorState,
  Grid,
  IconButton,
  Inline,
  ListItem,
  Loading,
  Page,
  PageSkeleton,
  Panel,
  Pill,
  type PillTone,
  Progress,
  Stack,
  Tabs,
  Text,
  Timeline,
  type TimelineItem,
  useConfirmDanger,
  useDelayedPending,
  useMessage,
} from 'vellum-ui'

type Status = 'active' | 'paused' | 'archived'

interface Member {
  readonly id: string
  readonly name: string
  readonly role: string
}

interface Project {
  readonly id: string
  readonly name: string
  /** A reference shown in a monospace font. */
  readonly key: string
  readonly owner: string
  readonly status: Status
  /** Decimal strings: amounts never go through floating point. */
  readonly budget: string
  readonly spent: string
  /** Share of the budget that is spent, computed by the server. */
  readonly spentPercent: number
  /** ISO dates. */
  readonly start: string
  readonly due: string
  readonly members: readonly Member[]
}

interface ActivityEvent {
  readonly id: string
  /** An ISO date-time. */
  readonly at: string
  readonly text: string
  readonly tone: TimelineItem['tone']
}

const PROJECT: Project = {
  id: 'p7',
  name: 'Website redesign',
  key: 'WEB-2026',
  owner: 'Alex Morgan',
  status: 'active',
  budget: '48250.00',
  spent: '31890.75',
  spentPercent: 66,
  start: '2026-09-01',
  due: '2026-12-15',
  members: [
    { id: 'm1', name: 'Alex Morgan', role: 'Owner' },
    { id: 'm2', name: 'Sam Lee', role: 'Designer' },
    { id: 'm3', name: 'Riley Chen', role: 'Developer' },
  ],
}

const ACTIVITY: readonly ActivityEvent[] = [
  { id: 'a1', at: '2026-09-01T09:00:00Z', text: 'Project created by Alex Morgan', tone: 'success' },
  {
    id: 'a2',
    at: '2026-09-18T14:30:00Z',
    text: 'Sam Lee uploaded the first mockups',
    tone: 'accent',
  },
  { id: 'a3', at: '2026-10-27T11:05:00Z', text: 'Budget raised to $48,250.00', tone: 'info' },
  {
    id: 'a4',
    at: '2026-11-04T16:45:00Z',
    text: 'Review of the home page planned',
    tone: 'neutral',
  },
]

const STATUS: Record<Status, { readonly label: string; readonly tone: PillTone }> = {
  active: { label: 'Active', tone: 'success' },
  paused: { label: 'Paused', tone: 'warning' },
  archived: { label: 'Archived', tone: 'neutral' },
}

const money = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD' })

const formatMoney = (amount: string) => money.format(amount as Intl.StringNumericLiteral)

const day = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { dateStyle: 'medium', timeZone: 'UTC' })

const formatDay = (iso: string) => day.format(new Date(iso))

const moment = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' })

const formatMoment = (iso: string) => moment.format(new Date(iso))

function navigate(path: string) {
  window.location.hash = `#${path}`
}

const LATENCY = 600

class ApiError extends Error {
  readonly code: string
  constructor(code: string) {
    super(code)
    this.code = code
  }
}

function readableError(error: unknown): string {
  if (error instanceof ApiError && error.code === 'unavailable')
    return 'The activity service is not responding. Try again in a moment.'
  return 'Something went wrong. Try again.'
}

function later<T>(answer: () => T): Promise<T> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) =>
    setTimeout(() => {
      try {
        resolve(answer())
      } catch (error) {
        reject(error)
      }
    }, LATENCY),
  )
}

function createServer() {
  let project = PROJECT
  let activityFailed = false
  return {
    project: () => later(() => project),
    activity: () => {
      // The first request fails, so that the error state can be seen; "Retry" succeeds
      const fail = !activityFailed
      return later(() => {
        if (fail) {
          activityFailed = true
          throw new ApiError('unavailable')
        }
        return ACTIVITY
      })
    },
    setStatus: (status: Status) =>
      later(() => {
        project = { ...project, status }
        return project
      }),
  }
}

interface Query<T> {
  /** The latest data, kept while a newer request runs. */
  readonly data: T | undefined
  /** A text for users when the latest request failed. */
  readonly error: string | undefined
  /** No response yet: the first load. */
  readonly isPending: boolean
  /** A request is running: the first load or a refresh. */
  readonly isFetching: boolean
  readonly refetch: () => void
}

function useFakeQuery<T>(fetcher: () => Promise<T>): Query<T> {
  const [state, setState] = useState<{
    readonly data?: T
    readonly error?: string
    readonly settled: boolean
    readonly fetching: boolean
  }>({ settled: false, fetching: true })
  const latest = useRef(0)
  const run = useCallback(() => {
    const id = ++latest.current
    setState((s) => ({ ...s, error: undefined, fetching: true }))
    fetcher().then(
      (data) => {
        if (id === latest.current) setState({ data, settled: true, fetching: false })
      },
      (error: unknown) => {
        if (id === latest.current)
          setState((s) => ({ ...s, error: readableError(error), settled: true, fetching: false }))
      },
    )
  }, [fetcher])
  useEffect(run, [run])
  return {
    data: state.data,
    error: state.error,
    isPending: !state.settled,
    isFetching: state.fetching,
    refetch: run,
  }
}

function ActivityTab(props: { readonly load: () => Promise<readonly ActivityEvent[]> }) {
  const activity = useFakeQuery(props.load)
  const showLoading = useDelayedPending(activity.isPending)
  if (activity.isPending || showLoading) return <Loading />
  if (activity.error)
    return <ErrorState size="sm" message={activity.error} onRetry={activity.refetch} />
  const events = activity.data ?? []
  if (events.length === 0) return <EmptyState size="sm" icon="activity" title="No activity yet" />
  return (
    <Timeline
      items={events.map((e) => ({
        key: e.id,
        tone: e.tone,
        content: (
          <Stack gap={1}>
            <Text>{e.text}</Text>
            <Text as="time" dateTime={e.at} size="sm" tone="secondary" numeric>
              {formatMoment(e.at)}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
        ),
      }))}
    />
  )
}

export function DetailPage() {
  const message = useMessage()
  const confirmDanger = useConfirmDanger()
  const [server] = useState(createServer)
  const project = useFakeQuery(server.project)
  const showSkeleton = useDelayedPending(project.isPending)
  if (project.isPending || showSkeleton) return <PageSkeleton variant="detail" />
  if (!project.data) return <ErrorState fill message={project.error} onRetry={project.refetch} />
  const p = project.data

  const archive = async () => {
    const previous = p.status
    await server.setStatus('archived')
    project.refetch()
    message.undoable({
      content: `Archived "${p.name}"`,
      onUndo: async () => {
        await server.setStatus(previous)
        project.refetch()
      },
    })
  }

  const remove = async () => {
    const ok = await confirmDanger({
      title: 'Delete project',
      description: 'Its files, budget and history are deleted as well. This cannot be undone.',
      // Irreversible: the name must be typed before "Delete" can be pressed
      confirmText: p.name,
      okText: 'Delete',
    })
    if (!ok) return
    message.success(`Deleted "${p.name}"`)
    navigate('/projects')
  }

  return (
    <Page
      title={p.name}
      subtitle={`Owned by ${p.owner}`}
      actions={
        <>
          <Button icon="edit" href={`#/projects/${p.id}/edit`}>
            Edit
          </Button>
          <Dropdown
            trigger={['click']}
            placement="bottomRight"
            menu={{
              items: [
                { key: 'duplicate', label: 'Duplicate', icon: 'copy' },
                {
                  key: 'archive',
                  label: 'Archive',
                  icon: 'archive',
                  disabled: p.status === 'archived',
                },
                { type: 'divider' },
                { key: 'delete', label: 'Delete', icon: 'trash', danger: true },
              ],
              onClick: ({ key }) => {
                if (key === 'duplicate') message.success(`Created "${p.name} (copy)"`)
                if (key === 'archive') archive()
                if (key === 'delete') remove()
              },
            }}
          >
            <IconButton icon="more" label="More actions" />
          </Dropdown>
        </>
      }
    >
      <Grid columns={2} gap={5}>
        <Panel title="Details">
          <Descriptions
            column={2}
            items={[
              {
                key: 'status',
                label: 'Status',
                children: (
                  <Pill tone={STATUS[p.status].tone} dot>
                    {STATUS[p.status].label}
                  </Pill>
                ),
              },
              { key: 'key', label: 'Reference', children: <Text mono>{p.key}</Text> },
              {
                key: 'owner',
                label: 'Owner',
                children: (
                  <Inline gap={2}>
                    <Avatar name={p.owner} size={20} />
                    <Text>{p.owner}</Text>
                  </Inline>
                ),
              },
              {
                key: 'budget',
                label: 'Budget',
                children: <Text numeric>{formatMoney(p.budget)}</Text>,
              },
              {
                key: 'start',
                label: 'Start',
                children: (
                  <Text as="time" dateTime={p.start} numeric>
                    {formatDay(p.start)}
                  </Text>
                ),
              },
              {
                key: 'due',
                label: 'Due',
                children: (
                  <Text as="time" dateTime={p.due} numeric>
                    {formatDay(p.due)}
                  </Text>
                ),
              },
            ]}
          />
        </Panel>
        <Panel title="Budget">
          <Stack gap={3}>
            <Text numeric>
              {formatMoney(p.spent)} spent of {formatMoney(p.budget)}
            </Text>
            {/* A meter: the tone says how close the spending is to the limit */}
            <Progress
              percent={p.spentPercent}
              tone={p.spentPercent >= 90 ? 'danger' : p.spentPercent >= 75 ? 'warning' : 'accent'}
              aria-label="Budget spent"
            />
            <Text size="sm" tone="secondary">
              Spending is updated every night from the approved invoices.
            </Text>
          </Stack>
        </Panel>
      </Grid>
      <Panel>
        <Tabs
          items={[
            {
              key: 'activity',
              label: 'Activity',
              children: <ActivityTab load={server.activity} />,
            },
            {
              key: 'members',
              label: 'Members',
              children: (
                <Stack gap={1}>
                  {p.members.map((m) => (
                    <ListItem
                      key={m.id}
                      leading={<Avatar name={m.name} size={32} />}
                      title={m.name}
                      description={m.role}
                    />
                  ))}
                </Stack>
              ),
            },
            {
              key: 'files',
              label: 'Files',
              children: (
                <EmptyState
                  size="sm"
                  icon="folder"
                  title="No files yet"
                  description="Files added to this project appear here"
                  action={<Button icon="upload">Upload files</Button>}
                />
              ),
            },
          ]}
        />
      </Panel>
    </Page>
  )
}
```
